title: A nonblank cell has been visited by its tape head
statement: Let $tm$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $t\\in\\mathbb{N}$, $i$ be a work-tape index, and $z\\in\\mathbb{Z}$. If cell $z$ of work tape $i$ contains a symbol after $tm$ runs for $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$, then the head of work tape $i$ occupied cell $z$ at some time from $0$ through $t$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: A machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$
Cell $z$ on tape $i$ is nonblank after $t$ steps from the initial configuration
